headword: {食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}
reading: しょくひんてんかぶつ

definitions.explanation: A substance added to food during processing to preserve it, enhance flavor, improve appearance, or extend shelf life.

examples.japanese: {食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}が{気|き}になる。
この{商品|しょうひん}には{食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}が{一切|いっさい}{使|つか}われていない。
examples.english: This product contains no food additives whatsoever.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}の{使用|しよう}は{食品衛生法|しょくひんえいせいほう}によって{厳|きび}しく{規制|きせい}されている。
examples.english: In Japan, the use of food additives is strictly regulated by the Food Sanitation Act.

notes:
A compound of {食品|しょくひん} (food products) and {添加物|てんかぶつ} (additive). This is a topic of significant public interest in Japan, where many consumers actively seek out {無添加|むてんか} (additive-free) products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}{不使用|ふしよう}: free from food additives
- {食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}の{表示|ひょうじ}: food additive labeling
- {食品添加物|しょくひんてんかぶつ}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid food additives
- {天然|てんねん}{添加物|てんかぶつ}: natural additives

RELATED WORDS:
- {無添加|むてんか}: additive-free — a major selling point in Japanese food marketing
- {保存料|ほぞんりょう}: preservative — one specific type of food additive
- {着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}: coloring agent — another common type of additive
- {防腐剤|ぼうふざい}: antiseptic, preservative — overlaps with {保存料|ほぞんりょう}
